observations.statement: Artwork save payload (PUT/POST /api/artworks) carries per-layer stroke_layers as array<{color,width}> on text and paragraph layers; legacy stroke_color/stroke_width equal stroke_layers[0] in 24/24 layers carrying both
schema_version = 2 at artwork top level (17/17 requests and responses) and on text/paragraph/spiral-text layers; absent on group layers and on synced layers of non-global templates
Linked paragraph (Duplicate & Link options) is saved with linked=<origin layer id>, its own stroke_enabled false and 1 stroke_layers entry while the origin has 3; response echoes it
spiral-text layers are saved without stroke_layers (stroke_color/stroke_width only); spiral render GET carries a single stroke in its config

Convert to Global Template: the template gets is_global true; added Template 1 (is_global false) holds layers with global_id pointing at the global layers, synced paragraph carries the same 3 stroke_layers
Campaign mockup PUT 200 persisted print-area layer-425851 (portal GET shows it) while fresh-v SDK JSON still lists only layer-566633 and campaign_mockup_printareas []
